brief:
# Plan Designer in AmberX: voice plans at zero Claude tokens (Brett, Nov 7)

Trigger: Brett says "let's make a plan" (voice, AmberX) or taps Plan Designer. It's part of Plan Studio, lives in AmberX (phone first; console view too).

1. Talk back and forth with a LOCAL agent: Ollama on the VPS (Brett is installing it), through assistant@1's existing Ollama provider. Small model (3-8B, CPU only, no GPU) chosen in settings; never uses Claude while drafting. Agent role: interviewer that asks clarifying questions, keeps an outline (goal, what, why, steps, acceptance, open questions), reads it back.
2. Voice in/out via AmberX talk mode (same mic/echo-safe path as Amber). Text editing too.
3. Draft saved locally/on the VPS as it goes (no loss on disconnect). Works if the VPS model is slow: show progress, allow plain dictation with no agent replies.
4. **Send to orchestrator**: one button/voice "send it" sends the whole draft in ONE request; the orchestrator (Claude) picks models, splits into ≤30-min steps, assigns the id. Show the token saving estimate.
5. If Ollama isn't installed/running: say so plainly with the setup line; dictation-only mode still works.
6. UI from assets, settings in place, no hard-coded styling. UI Review three options (--choices). Tests (mock Ollama). Add to Shipped features.

Progress: append `<time> START|DONE <step>` to PROGRESS.md here at each step; don't stop between steps. Commit, don't push.

steps.text: Designer core: draft@1 shape, interviewer prompt + reply parsing, read-back, voice intents, token-saving estimate, orchestrator split prompt + parse
Server: Ollama status/models, turn jobs with progress (Ollama only, never Claude), drafts on the VPS, send = one Claude call + orchestrator add (capability axf.orchestrator@1)
Web: Plan Designer page (outline editor, conversation, dictation-only, send with estimate), local draft cache, settings in place, layout assets
Voice: talk loop on the mic lease + AmberX echo gate, 'let's make a plan' / 'send it' / 'read it back' voice commands
Tests with a mock Ollama (core, server, CLI), checks (theme, controls, toolbars, chrome, lifecycle)
Three layout options as assets, shots, UI Review submit with --choices; Shipped features, docs, THREADS
